title: Three Things Hashem Cries Over
summary: The tears Hashem sheds over the churban, and the three people He cries over each day: one who could learn and doesn't, one who can't and does, and a leader who lords it over the community. Rebbi's blessing to "greet the Face that sees and is not seen," how the Rebbe saw each person in front of him, Rav Idi who traveled three months for one day of learning, and what one hour of learning is worth.
key_ideas: Hashem cries over one who could learn and doesn't, and over one who struggles to learn and still does.
A leader must not lord it over the community.
Seeing each person, face to face, is a great thing.
Even one day, or one hour, of learning is precious.
